visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with dark brown hair and a black striped jacket speaks into a professional condenser microphone. He has an animated expression, gesturing with his hands. The background is a dimly lit studio with grey vertical textures. (2) Cut to a second man wearing a light beige turtleneck and a surgical mask, listening and nodding. The background shows blurred shelves with books and plants. (3) The first man reappears, speaking directly to the camera. A cartoon graphic of a brown wallet with a pink banknote floating above it appears near his hands to illustrate his point. (4) Close-up of a black leather wallet being held by hands. The wallet features gold embossed text including 'plain-me' and a tiger illustration. The setting is a wooden table. (5) Hands demonstrate the internal features of the wallet, pulling out a hidden compartment and placing a gold coin into a small pocket labeled with variety text. (6) A split-screen view shows the wallet's interior structure with yellow labels identifying various compartments (Banknotes, Coins, Receipts) at the top, while the man continues talking in the bottom half. (7) Macro close-up shots highlight the leather's grain and texture under water droplets, showing its water-resistant properties, followed by a close-up of a gold YKK zipper pull. (8) The man holds the wallet and a gold box, standing next to a pile of coins and a graphic of a cartoon tiger. Promotional text and a QR code appear as overlays on the screen.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a clear, energetic male voice speaking with high articulation clarity. There is no background music initially, creating a conversational studio atmosphere. (2) A second male voice responds with a muffled quality, indicating he is wearing a mask or speaking from a slight distance. (3) An upbeat electronic BGM track starts, featuring a steady 4/4 beat and bright synthesizer pads. The main speaker continues with a high speech rate and animated pitch contours. (4) A digital UI sound effect (a soft 'pop') triggers as visual graphics appear on screen. The BGM remains consistent in the background. (5) As the promotional segment begins, the main speaker's tone shifts to a professional narrative style. Transient sounds of leather rustling and the sharp metallic click of a zipper being opened are layered into the mix during the product demonstration. (6) A 'whoosh' transition SFX occurs during a scene cut. The audio ends with the main speaker delivering a enthusiastic call to action, accompanied by a slight swell in the BGM volume.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Problem -> Solution -> Features -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a promotional advertisement for the 'TIGER' wallet by plain-me. It starts with a humorous hook about Taiwanese superstitions regarding money and wallets to grab attention. It then positions the product as a modern solution that incorporates traditional 'good luck' elements (like the pocket for a money mother/amulet) while offering high-quality materials and practical organization features. The video ends with a specific promo code and call to action to drive sales during a crowdfunding campaign.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The host explicitly introduces the product name, describes its features, displays brand logos, and provides a discount code for viewers.

high_inference.freeDescribe: High-quality production combining podcast-style talking head segments with professional product b-roll. The integration of local cultural elements (Hoo-ia/superstition) makes it highly relatable to the target audience.
